abstract: BACKGROUND: Testicular cancer is one of the few solid cancers that can be cured even when it is metastasized with overall survival rate of more than 90%. The aim of this study was to establish the age adjusted incidence of testicular cancer and to critically assess the management of testicular tumor. METHODS: This is a quantitative retrospective study utilizing a review of clinical notes for patients who underwent testicular orchidectomy. The number of cancer cases, types of pathology and cancer staging were examined. RESULTS: There is no substantial difference between the crude and the age-standardized incidence, moreover no difference from the reported crude incidence by the Scottish intercollegiate guidelines. We found 55.1% of seminoma, 14.28% of non-seminoma and 30.61% of combined (seminoma and non-seminoma), and stage I disease in 61.22% of cases, stage II in 36.73% of cases, and stage IV in 2.04% of cases. Most of the cancers were in the age group 20 - 50 with the majority (48.97%) in the age group 31 - 40. About 42.85% of cases were identified with high tumor markers; higher percentage of seminoma at stage II (40.74%). CONCLUSIONS: There is no substantial difference between the crude and the age-standardized incidence, moreover no difference from the reported crude incidence. Most of the cancers were in the age group 20 - 50 with the majority (48.97%) in the age group 31 - 40. Only 25% of seminomas had elevated tumor markers. Moreover, it is important to re-enforce strict adaptation to the IGCCCG prognostic factor-based classifications.
abstract_ja:
背景：精巣がんは、転移していても治癒可能な数少ない固形がんの一つであり、全生存率は90%を超える。本研究の目的は、年齢調整罹患率を算出し、精巣腫瘍の管理を批判的に評価することであった。
方法：精巣摘除術を受けた患者の診療録をレビューした定量的後方視的研究。がん症例数、病理組織型、病期分類を検討した。
結果：粗罹患率と年齢調整罹患率の間に大きな差はなく、報告されている粗罹患率との差もなかった。セミノーマは55.1%、非セミノーマは14.28%、混合型は30.61%であった。病期Iは61.22%、病期IIは36.73%、病期IVは2.04%であった。大半は20〜50歳で、最多は31〜40歳(48.97%)であった。症例の約42.85%で腫瘍マーカーが高値であった。病期IIのセミノーマでは高値の割合が高かった(40.74%)。
結論：粗罹患率と年齢調整罹患率の間に大きな差はなく、報告された粗罹患率とも差はなかった。大半は20〜50歳で、最多は31〜40歳(48.97%)であった。セミノーマの25%のみで腫瘍マーカーが上昇していた。また、IGCCCG予後因子に基づく分類への厳格な準拠を再確認することが重要である。
